description: This multi-level pie chart illustrates a hierarchical categorization of medical ethics principles, featuring an inner circle of four primary categories and an outer ring of twenty-six specific sub-categories. The inner circle is divided into four solid-colored slices: "Beneficence" (blue, approximately 42%), "Autonomy" (green, approximately 28%), "Non-Maleficence" (purple, approximately 18%), and "Justice" (orange, approximately 12%). The outer ring uses lighter shades of these colors to group corresponding sub-categories. The light blue "Beneficence" section contains eleven slices: "Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation," "Comply with Laws and Regulations," "Provide Medical Care to Patients," "Continual Learning," "Provide Assistance in Emergency," "Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues," "Respect Life, Dignity of Patients," "Give Top Priority to Patient's Interest in Conflict of Interests," "Minimizing Conflicts of Interest," "Ethical research," and "Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees." The light orange "Justice" section comprises four slices: "Promote the Health of Community and Public Education," "Promote Environmental Sustainability," "Allocate Medical Sources Fairly," and "Treat Patients Fairly and Equally." The light purple "Non-Maleficence" section includes four slices: "Prevent Patient from Harm," "Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care," "Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct," and "Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain." The light green "Autonomy" section is divided into seven slices: "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve," "Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement," "Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives," "Keep Confidential of Patient's Information," "Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication," "Respect Patient's Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice," and "Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient." The chart lacks a separate legend and numerical percentage labels; all text is positioned directly within the slices, radiating outward from the center. The inner circle labels are visually emphasized with bold text, and the segments do not appear to be ordered by size within their respective color groupings.
